content.text: --- ## COMPREHENSIVE RESEARCH REPORT: Icon vs. Logo CSS Glyph Systems I've completed a thorough investigation of pantoken's icon and logo systems. Here are the key findings: --- ### **1. ICON UTILITY: Mask-Based Painter Mechanism** **File: [formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css#L1-L25)** The icon system uses a **shared generic mask painter** that catches any CSS class containing `-icon-`: ```css [class*="-icon-"]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; inline-size: 1em; /* Fixed 1:1 aspect ratio */ block-size: 1em; flex: none; vertical-align: -0.125em; background: currentColor; -webkit-mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; /* The key line */ mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; } ``` The `-icon-` modifier class sets `--pantoken-glyph` to point at the actual SVG token. **Icons are always 1:1 squares** (1em × 1em) because the `::before` pseudo-element is hardcoded that way. --- ### **2. Logo Plugin: Aspect Ratio METADATA IS AVAILABLE** **File: [plugins/pantoken/logos/src/index.ts](plugins/pantoken/logos/src/index.ts#L35-L70)** The `LogoMeta` interface stores **both width and height derived from SVG viewBox**: ```ts export interface LogoMeta { product: Product; layout: LogoLayout; colorMode: LogoColorMode; lang?: LogoLang; name: string; path: string; width: number; /* Fixed per layout group: 478px or 239px */ height: number; /* DERIVED FROM SVG viewBox ASPECT RATIO */ } ``` **This is critical**: The `height` field is **not arbitrary**—it's calculated at build time from each logo's SVG viewBox ratio. --- ### **3. HOW ASPECT RATIO IS CALCULATED AT BUILD TIME** **File: [plugins/pantoken/logos/scripts/generate.ts](plugins/pantoken/logos/scripts/generate.ts#L84-L130)** ```ts function parseViewBox(svg: string): [number, number] | undefined { const match = /viewBox="[\d.-]+\s+[\d.-]+\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)"/u.exec(svg); if (!match) return undefined; return [Number.parseFloat(match[1]), Number.parseFloat(match[2])]; } function rasterize(svg: string, displayWidth: number) { const viewBox = parseViewBox(svg); const aspect = viewBox ? viewBox[1] / viewBox[0] : 1; /* height/width from viewBox */ const height = Math.round(displayWidth * aspect); /* Aspect-aware height */ const png = new Resvg(svg, { fitTo: { mode: "width", value: displayWidth * RASTER_SCALE } }) .render() .asPng(); return { png, width: displayWidth, height }; } ``` **Layout-specific widths** (hardcoded, derived from Canvas theme editor's max-width): - Word-mark/lockup layouts: **478px** - Icon layouts: **239px** (half of word-mark) - Rasterization: 2x scale for retina sharpness, then downscaled via `` **Example**: If a horizontal logo SVG has `viewBox="0 0 661.85 168.41"`: - Aspect ratio = 168.41 / 661.85 ≈ 0.254 - Display height = 478px × 0.254 ≈ 122px - Stored in LogoMeta: `{ width: 478, height: 122 }` These values are embedded in `generated/embedded.ts` as the `LOGOS` array, available at token-generation time. --- ### **4. TinyMCE: Why Logos Use `` Instead of CSS Classes** **File: [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/logos.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/logos.ts#L150-L180)** ```ts export function generateLogoHtml(meta: LogoMeta, url: string): string { return ``; } ``` **Icons** (from [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts#L60)): ```ts insertHtml(editor, buildIconMarkup(icon)); // Generates ``` **Why the difference?** - Canvas LMS RCE (rich-text editor) **strips inline `` survives** Canvas's sanitization - Logos must be rasterized PNG files at build time for Canvas compatibility - Icons can use CSS class + mask painter because icons don't need to survive Canvas RCE stripping (they're used in different contexts, e.g., Instructure UI components) --- ### **5. CURRENT LOGO CSS GENERATION** **File: [plugins/pantoken/logos/generated/logos.css](plugins/pantoken/logos/generated/logos.css#L1-L50)** Logos are currently **maskable like icons** (both are solid-fill SVGs): ```css :root { --instui-logo-canvas-horizontal-color: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,..."); --instui-logo-canvas-horizontal-dark: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,..."); /* ... many more ... */ } .-icon-canvas-horizontal-color { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-logo-canvas-horizontal-color); } .-icon-canvas-horizontal-dark { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-logo-canvas-horizontal-dark); } ``` **Key insight**: Logos reuse the **same `-icon-*` painter** because they're solid-fill SVGs. But: - The CSS tokens are data-URI SVGs (not rasterized PNGs) - The `:before` pseudo-element is still 1:1 (inappropriate for logos with different aspect ratios) --- ### **6. Modifier Convention Pattern** **File: [docs/conventions/authoring.md](docs/conventions/authoring.md#L100-L130)** All component modifiers follow: `.${prefix}.--` Examples: - `-color-secondary`, `-size-sm`, `-shape-circle`, `-variant-title-page` - A new `-logo-*` utility would follow: `.-logo-` or `.-logo-{product}-{layout}-{colormode}` **Critical gotcha** (from [docs/engineering-log.md](docs/engineering-log.md#L170-L180)): ```markdown ### A `-icon-` modifier hits the glyph painter **Symptom** — A modifier named `-icon-position-end` rendered a solid square on the element. **Root cause** — The generic `[class*="-icon-"]::before` mask painter matched the modifier and tried to paint an undefined glyph. **Fix / rule** — Never name a modifier with a `-icon-` substring unless it's a real glyph. ``` **For `-logo-*`**: The same rule applies—never use `-logo-` substring in non-glyph modifiers. --- ### **7. Aspect Ratio Data Available for CSS Generation** The logos plugin could emit per-logo CSS properties at build time. Currently **NOT generated**: - Per-logo aspect ratio: `aspect-ratio: ${meta.width} / ${meta.height}` - Per-layout aspect ratio: `.--logo-icon { aspect-ratio: 1; }`, `.--logo-horizontal { aspect-ratio: 478/122; }` - Per-logo custom properties: `--logo-canvas-horizontal-color-width: 478px; --logo-canvas-horizontal-color-height: 122px;` The data exists in `LOGOS: LogoMeta[]` at token-generation time. It's a code-generation decision to emit these. --- ### **8. Security Context** **File: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)** Logos are treated as **trusted input** (like icons): - SVG sanitization happens at **decode time** (source layer, in `@pantoken/icons`) and **encode time** (output layer, in `@pantoken/core`) - No scripts, event handlers, or SMIL animations survive the sanitization pipeline - Mask-based painters (CSS masks) are safe—they don't execute scripts, only render pixels **File: [ASSURANCE.md](ASSURANCE.md#L1-L100)** The assurance case states pantoken is **not a general-purpose sanitizer** for untrusted input, but SVG handling is verified for trusted design-system inputs via automated tests. --- ### **9. Summary: Key Differences Between Icons and Logos** | Aspect | Icons | Logos | |--------|-------|-------| | **Aspect ratio** | 1:1 (hardcoded) | Variable (SVG viewBox-derived) | | **CSS painter** | `.instui-icon` with fixed 1em×1em `:before` | Currently uses same `-icon-*` painter (inappropriate) | | **HTML insertion** | `` | `` (Canvas RCE safety) | | **Data format** | Data-URI SVGs (CSS) | Both data-URI SVGs (CSS) AND rasterized PNGs (Canvas RCE) | | **Metadata in IR** | Width/height not tracked separately | LogoMeta includes width/height from viewBox | | **CSS tokens** | `--instui-icon-` | `--instui-logo---` | | **Modifier convention** | `.-icon-` | Currently `.-icon-` (reuses icon painter) | --- ### **To Plan a New "-logo-*" Utility** The research shows: 1. **Aspect ratio metadata is already available** (LogoMeta.width / LogoMeta.height) 2. **CSS could emit per-logo aspect-ratio properties** during logos plugin build 3. **A new `.instui-logo` utility with `-logo-*` modifiers** could accept variable heights via `aspect-ratio` or explicit `height` property 4. **The modifier convention** follows existing patterns: `.-logo-{identifier}` 5. **Security**: SVG sanitization is already in place for logos; mask-based painters are safe 6. **Canvas RCE**: For Canvas LMS contexts, the current `` approach with rasterized PNGs is necessary The detailed findings have been saved to session memory for reference.

content.text: ## Plan: `-logo-*` aspect-ratio-aware mask glyph (replaces PNG raster) Icons mask a glyph via a hardcoded 1em×1em `[class*="-icon-"]::before` painter. Logos currently *reuse that exact painter* (`.-icon-` classes emitted by the logos plugin generator), which squishes non-square logos — that's why a PNG-rasterize-and-`` workaround was built for Canvas RCE instead. Per your answers, we'll build a proper `-logo-*` mask utility that respects each logo's real aspect ratio, and use it in Canvas RCE too (dropping PNG generation), since icons already prove bare-class markup survives Canvas RCE's sanitizer. **Steps** **Phase 1 — new `-logo-*` utility in `@pantoken/components`** *(independent, do first)* 1. Add [formats/components/src/utilities/logo/logo.css](formats/components/src/utilities/logo/logo.css), modeled on [icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css) but with `aspect-ratio: var(--pantoken-logo-aspect, 1)` instead of hardcoded `1em × 1em`, block-level display, and `@accessibility` guidance for `role="img"`/`aria-label` (logos aren't decorative). 2. Add matching `index.ts`, register in `utilities/index.ts`'s `UTILITIES` array and re-export from `formats/components/src/index.ts`. 3. Add a drift-checked test mirroring the icon utility's test. **Phase 2 — rewrite `plugins/pantoken/logos` generator** *(depends on Phase 1's class name)* 1. In [generate.ts](plugins/pantoken/logos/scripts/generate.ts), remove `Resvg`/`rasterize()`/PNG writes/layout-width scaling; derive aspect straight from each SVG's own `viewBox`. 2. Change `glyphRule()` to emit `.-logo-` + a `--pantoken-logo-aspect: / ` custom property. 3. Update `LogoMeta.width`/`height` semantics (natural viewBox aspect, not PNG display size) in `src/index.ts`. 4. Drop the `@resvg/resvg-js` dependency and `./*.png` export from `package.json`; delete stale `generated/*.png`/`dist/*.png`. **Phase 3 — TinyMCE Canvas RCE insertion** *(depends on Phase 2)* 1. Replace `` PNG insertion in [logos.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/logos.ts) with mask markup mirroring `buildIconMarkup()` — non-decorative (`role="img" aria-label`), `contenteditable="false"`. 2. Add `getLogoCdnFile()`/`getUsedLogoCdnFiles()` mirroring the icon equivalents, wired through `trackAndInjectAsset()`. 3. Wire `getUsedLogoCdnFiles` into `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl` alongside the existing `getUsedIconCdnFiles` call. 4. Update/add tests mirroring `icons.test.ts`. **Phase 4 — cleanup** *(depends on 1–3)* 1. Resolve the pending `.changeset/logo-png-canvas-rce.md` (delete+replace if unreleased, else add a reversal changeset) and add fresh changesets for the affected packages. 2. Check `ASSURANCE.md`/`SECURITY.md` for stale PNG-rasterization security language. 3. Update `docs/conventions/authoring.md` / demo pages and `ai/pantoken-ai` assets if they reference the old approach. **Relevant files** - [formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css) — template for the new logo painter - [plugins/pantoken/logos/scripts/generate.ts](plugins/pantoken/logos/scripts/generate.ts) — drop rasterization, emit `-logo-*` + aspect ratio - [plugins/pantoken/logos/src/index.ts](plugins/pantoken/logos/src/index.ts) — `LogoMeta` semantics update - [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/logos.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/logos.ts) — swap `` for mask markup - [renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts) — pattern to mirror (`buildIconMarkup`, `getIconCdnFile`, `getUsedIconCdnFiles`) - [renderers/tinymce/src/content-css.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/content-css.ts) — `trackAndInjectAsset()` reused as-is - `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl` — wire in `getUsedLogoCdnFiles` **Verification** 1. `vp run generate` in `plugins/pantoken/logos`; confirm zero `.png` output and correct `--pantoken-logo-aspect` per logo. 2. `vp check --fix && vp test`, then `pnpm run check:publish`. 3. Browser-check an inserted logo renders undistorted (use the already-open canvas-rce guide page). 4. Confirm `editor.getContent()` round-trip contains only class-based markup, no inline SVG/style. **Further Considerations** 1. Tag choice (`` vs ``) for the inserted logo element — match whatever `.instui-icon`'s own doc convention uses. 2. Default `inline-size` for `-logo-*` (icons hardcode 1em; logos need a real default width) — needs a concrete value chosen during Phase 1. Full detail is saved in [plan.md](/memories/session/plan.md).
